naslov: Anthropic's sandbox-runtime: protection for agents without Docker
opis:
Anthropic's open-source sandbox-runtime tool (the `srt` command) is gaining popularity. It's the same protection used by the bash tool in Claude Code.

Why it matters: If you run agents or npm scripts you don't fully trust, then after the recent compromised packages this is a cheap way to keep .env and ~/.ssh out of reach.

naslov: Study: a pricier harness doesn't make a coding agent better
opis:
A controlled experiment compared the harnesses (the frameworks that guide a model through a task) Claude Code, OpenCode and mini-SWE-agent. Switching harnesses moves the share of solved tasks barely more than simply rerunning the same setup.

Why it matters: The length of your system prompt and CLAUDE.md affects your API bill more than your choice of tool.

naslov: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B: a small open model for voice agents in about 4 GB
opis:
NVIDIA has released a small open model for local conversational agents: voice assistants, game characters and robots. It's built from Google's Gemma 4 E4B with additional training using only reinforcement learning. It has 8 billion parameters, 4 billion of them effective, and a 64K-token context.

Why it matters: A tool-calling model that runs on an ordinary RTX card leaves room for speech and vision recognition on the same machine.
